source: palette.html — base black variant, renamed to terminal-meaningful roles

accent.role: 主役アクセント・CTA（カーソル）

ansi_mapping.note: palette.html only defines 9 colors. Slots without a direct match (magenta, cyan, and all bright_* variants) reuse the nearest color in this palette by hue.

consumers.nvim.lua: Lua table keyed by semantic name (free-form), dofile'd directly by nvim/.config/nvim/lua/theme/init.lua.
consumers.tmux.conf: tmux user options (@bg, @surface, @border, @fg, @accent, @accent2, @success, @error, @warning — free-form, tmux does not require @color0..@color15), consumed via #{@name} by tmux/.tmux.conf.
consumers.alacritty.toml: Static TOML with a fixed schema (colors.normal.black/red/green/... are alacritty-defined field names, not renameable); hex values hand-kept in sync with this reference, semantic name noted per line as a comment.
consumers.sequences: Raw OSC escape bytes written straight to the terminal, fixed ANSI slot numbers (no comments possible); hex values hand-kept in sync with this reference.
